label: TSMM to OpenID Federation binding
description: Maps OpenID Federation concepts into TSMM abstractions for cross-ecosystem reasoning and topology comparison.

mappings.description: Participating domain within a governed federation context.
Operates governance logic and authority chains for the federation.
Registry-like publication and trust anchor function over federation statements.
Entity issuing signed assertions or tokens into the trust ecosystem.
Verifier of signed assertions, metadata, and trust chains.
Signed metadata artifact functioning as a credential-like trust assertion under policy and governance constraints.

notes: OpenID Federation distributes authority through signed metadata, which TSMM models as a governance and publication graph.
The mapping is approximate where federation semantics bundle governance and publication roles together.

guarantees.name: topology-comparison
guarantees.description: Federation roles and signed statements can be compared with TSMM governance and credential abstractions.

guarantees.name: signed-metadata-modeling
guarantees.description: Entity statements can be represented as credential-like TSMM artifacts under policy.

guarantees.name: delegation-fidelity
guarantees.description: Federation authority chains are comparable, but TSMM does not copy every federation processing rule.

limitations.name: statement-processing rules
limitations.impact: TSMM does not encode the full OpenID Federation processing algorithm.
limitations.mitigation: Use federation normative texts for trust chain evaluation logic.

behavioralExpectations.expectation: Consumers model entity statements as governed trust artifacts, not merely as static metadata blobs.
Federation operators and authorities are separated analytically even when operational deployments combine them.

notes: Binding remains subject to ecosystem-specific review and does not establish certification.
